iterations.head: bb8220e5e1ea5205380c460e618ace8992e6f2b9
iterations.cause: The local built app emitted expected 404/MIME console errors for two Vercel telemetry scripts, and the console gate ran before complete evidence was written
iterations.fix: Classify only the two exact same-origin telemetry paths, retain raw errors, and defer the gate until after reports and captures

iterations.head: e07e45c6de1e053a39379c10fb5dd8ef0d15f2f7
iterations.cause: Chromium computed the repository's 0.01ms reduced-motion transition as 1e-05s while the harness required the literal value 0s
iterations.fix: Parse the computed duration and require it to be at most the repository's exact 0.01ms cutoff

iterations.head: 3569f9de7f2ad14ea40af36085cdcf007eb598f5
iterations.cause: Desktop and reduced-motion interaction observations were 216ms and 248ms; telemetry MIME errors were still classified as unexpected
iterations.fix: Anchor the exact embedded telemetry URL classification and settle fonts plus two animation frames around measured interactions while retaining the 200ms budget

iterations.head: 72f3056400916e187f61b02f50515084bf8c3753
iterations.cause: The sole remaining gate failure was a 208ms desktop cold atlas navigation; the isolated typography specimens also still included fixed host chrome
iterations.fix: Scroll the cold link into view and settle fonts plus paint before the same measured click; hide and assert only the two known overlays on isolated specimens

iterations.head: 5f58391e087405bd0d798415543ec4f3e55554f7
iterations.cause: Build and browser gates passed with desktop/mobile/reduced interaction observations of 160ms, 64ms, and 80ms and zero unexpected console or page errors
iterations.fix: None; accepted for shared layout and harness regression evidence, not final 12-entry release proof

iterations.head: 70cd4344497fadee5cfa6aff1716aebf7a2702ec

iterations.cause: The fresh blocked-font page exposed two matches for an unscoped type-specimen locator; the artifact stopped before fallback specimen and manifest creation
iterations.fix: Require exactly one visible specimen inside main, sample the visible dossier heading and specimen descendants after fonts and paint settle, and preserve failure for multiple visible desks

iterations.head: 43d42395915d09d623eba2fd95cbda1fdec2a09a
